mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 1% MoM AND UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k AND UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 12-month MA.
